capabilities.name: Club recognition and establishment
capabilities.summary: Recognize an existing club or establish a new organization record.
capabilities.house_contribution: Organization registry read/write; no create/bootstrap path (V1-11, V1-14.5).
capabilities.unresolved_validation: Historical-club eligibility rules pending operational validation (Jen).
capabilities.release_hypothesis: Included in first release (recognition or establishment).

capabilities.name: Jurisdiction resolution
capabilities.summary: Resolve the province/PTSO jurisdiction that governs an organization.
capabilities.current_process_contribution: Jurisdiction known informally; no system routing (V1-16, FND-037).
capabilities.unresolved_validation: Provincial jurisdiction boundaries pending Member-Association validation.

capabilities.name: Seasonal affiliation lifecycle
capabilities.summary: The governed affiliation state machine for a season.
capabilities.base44_contribution: Tiered affiliation concept (CAP-001, V1-07) — strongest reusable product asset.
capabilities.house_contribution: Governance Kernel + affiliation FSM, guards, idempotency (V1-12).
capabilities.unresolved_validation: None material for state authority; seasonal boundary rules pending operational validation.
capabilities.release_hypothesis: Included in first release (seasonal affiliation creation + lifecycle).

capabilities.name: Versioned affiliation requirements
capabilities.summary: Determine the applicable, versioned requirement set for an affiliation.
capabilities.house_contribution: Policy versioning primitives; requirements not yet versioned (V1-14.3).
capabilities.unresolved_validation: Requirement content and versioning cadence pending policy validation.

capabilities.name: Evidence capture and binding
capabilities.summary: Upload and bind evidence artifacts to a governed affiliation.
capabilities.house_contribution: Evidence metadata, hashing, storage, malware scan/quarantine; upload path unwired (V1-12, V1-14.3).
capabilities.current_process_contribution: Documents emailed and filed manually (V1-16, DATA-DOCS).

capabilities.name: Fee determination
capabilities.summary: Determine fees owed for an affiliation.
capabilities.house_contribution: No fee-policy domain today; would be governed domain state (V1-11).
capabilities.current_process_contribution: Fees computed manually and invoiced (V1-16, DATA-PAYMENTS).
capabilities.external_dependency: Payment processor executes charges (SRC-007); accounting retains ledger truth (SRC-012).
capabilities.unresolved_validation: Fee schedule and economics pending financial validation (Helene).
capabilities.release_hypothesis: Included in first release (fee determination + payment-reconciliation boundary).

capabilities.name: Reviewer routing and assignment
capabilities.summary: Route a submitted affiliation to the correct reviewer.
capabilities.current_process_contribution: Reviewer chosen manually by staff (V1-16, FND-037).
capabilities.unresolved_validation: Reviewer assignment rules pending operational validation.
capabilities.release_hypothesis: Included in first release (assigned reviewer routing).

capabilities.name: Return-for-information and resubmission
capabilities.summary: Return an application for more information and accept a resubmission.
capabilities.release_hypothesis: Included in first release (return and resubmission).

capabilities.name: Governed decision and exactly-once activation
capabilities.summary: Record the governed decision and activate the affiliation exactly once.
capabilities.unresolved_validation: Governed database behaviour unproven without a deployed environment (V1-14.5).
capabilities.release_hypothesis: Included in first release (governed decision + exactly-once activation).

capabilities.name: Payment execution
capabilities.summary: Execute the payment transaction for an affiliation fee.
capabilities.current_process_contribution: Payments taken via existing processors (V1-18, DATA-PAYMENTS).
capabilities.external_dependency: Payment processors (SRC-007) — execute transactions, do not define fee policy.
capabilities.unresolved_validation: Processor selection and terms pending financial validation (Helene).
capabilities.release_hypothesis: Included at the payment-reconciliation boundary only (not full billing).

capabilities.name: Accounting and ledger truth
capabilities.current_process_contribution: Accounting system retains ledger authority (V1-18, SRC-012).
capabilities.unresolved_validation: Reconciliation format and cadence pending financial validation (Helene).
capabilities.release_hypothesis: Externalized; only the reconciliation boundary is in first release.

capabilities.name: Authoritative status projection
capabilities.summary: Expose authoritative affiliation status to The Button and integrations.
capabilities.base44_contribution: Client-facing guided experience (V1-06, V1-09) — Button role.
capabilities.house_contribution: Authoritative state + read model + outbox projection (V1-11, V1-12).
capabilities.unresolved_validation: Button surface scope pending experience validation.
capabilities.release_hypothesis: Included in first release (Button status + required-action view + notifications + audit visibility).
